breadcrumbs.surfaces: First shell-company invoice bearing Voss's registered-agent signature block. Establishes the paperwork trail the whole network eventually hangs on.
A second shell company, same registered-agent boilerplate as bc_voss_invoice, different shell name.
An unidentified large man seen leaving a scene calmly, pre-dating his identification as Boone in Case 30.
A shell company leases the storage unit at the center of the case; dressed to match Voss's compliance-consultant cover once that profession is locked in.
Boone confirmed as a contract cleaner taking anonymous jobs; first direct link from a body to the network's cleanup arm.
A wire transfer routed through two of the shell companies already seeded in bc_voss_invoice / bc_shell_receipt.
A partial offshore ledger page; numbers don't resolve yet but the account prefix recurs later in bc_network_map_partial.
A witness describes being warned off by a woman's voice on the phone — first trace of Nadia before she's named.
A witness recants under pressure that doesn't match the case at hand — Nadia's fixer work, still unattributed.
A forged notary stamp matching the registered-agent cover from bc_shell_lease. Confirms the shell network is centrally run, not incidental.
Okafor talks the player out of pulling a thread that, in hindsight, led toward the network. Internal only — never framed as suspicious in any player-facing text.
A partial org chart recovered from a cleanup job gone wrong; account prefix matches bc_offshore_ledger.
A physical signature sample for Voss, first time the name is attached to actual handwriting rather than typed paperwork.
Handwriting analysis on a network ledger returns a partial match the player isn't shown in full. Internal escalation of bc_okafor_hesitation toward the Case 08/31/34 reveal arc.
The completed network map, ready to pay off at the finale. Last breadcrumb before the story-gate case.

callbacks.note: The staged-scene technique first seen in Case 14 (a break-in dressed to look random) reappears refined in Boone's overdose staging.
Same registered-agent boilerplate language links the two shell-company breadcrumbs.
The notary stamp forged in Case 25 matches the registration paperwork style from Case 12.
The offshore account prefix from Case 18's ledger fragment recurs in the partial org chart recovered in Case 33.
Okafor's steer-away in Case 28 gets a quiet, unresolved echo when his handwriting partially matches a ledger in Case 39.
The partial org chart from Case 33 completes into the full network map that gates the finale.
